inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: Q2 2026 weighted-average diluted 455M (10-Q, quarter to 2026-06-30); period-end basic 445M + ~10M dilutive RSUs/PSUs. Held FLAT because SBC (incl. equity-award withholding) is fully expensed in the flows; charging both would double-count. eBay is a heavy repurchaser ($2.5B FY2025, $809M H1 2026, $2.0B authorisation remaining) so the flat count is funded, not a convention.
inputs.cash_note: Cash & equivalents 2,310 + available-for-sale debt securities 2,541 (997 maturing within one year, 1,544 longer) at 2026-06-30. The AFS securities are included because their interest is stripped from FCF (matching-asset rule). Restricted cash (446) and customer funds are excluded. The $1.4B Depop cash payment closed 2026-07-30, after the balance-sheet date, and is deducted in equity_bridge rather than restated into net_debt.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2025 filed FCF (OCF 1,959 - capex 525) = 1,434 is depressed by ~$1.0B of income tax paid in Q2 2025 on the FY2024 Adevinta share-sale gain (FY2025 cash taxes 1,457 vs a 267 current-tax charge and ~450 normal; Q2 2025 alone paid 1,094 and OCF was -340). reported_fcf is normalised to 2,434 (= 1,434 + 1,000). TTM to Jun-2026, which excludes that quarter, is OCF 3,036 - capex 608 = 2,428, corroborating the normalised level.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K cash-flow statement: ShareBasedCompensation 607 + PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation 273 (financing). eBay publishes no combined SBC-plus-equity-tax line in XBRL, so the two lines are summed per the house method. Note: in a flat-share-count model the 273 withholding is arguably already inside the 607 grant-date expense (withheld shares are part of the vested award); charging it is the house convention and is worth roughly $8-10/share versus SBC-only.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 InvestmentIncomeInterest 265 (FY2024 272; H1 2026 116). Stripped because cash + AFS securities of 4.85B exceed the owner-FCF base; the pile is credited once, in net debt.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. Risk-free ~4.2% (10y UST), ERP 5.0%, beta ~1.05-1.3 (5y regression ~1.3; fundamental beta for a mature marketplace nearer 1.0) gives cost of equity 9.5-10.7%. Debt 6.7B at ~4.5% pre-tax (3.6% after tax) is ~12% of capital against a 49B market cap. Blended WACC 8.7-9.8%; 9.0% used in all three scenarios. Risk is charged once, through scenario weights, not per-scenario discount rates.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (liability 395 at 2026-06-30, ROU asset 394) are immaterial (<1% of EV). Lease cost stays inside EBITDA as an operating expense (US GAAP operating-lease rent is in opex); lease liabilities are NOT added to net debt. One treatment, applied consistently.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 1: operating company, consumer internet / marketplace, US filer in USD; no adaptations file needed). FY0 = FY2025 (Dec year-end); year 1 = FY2026, the guidance year. Adj EBITDA margin is pre-SBC: FY2025 GAAP operating income 2,277 + D&A 421 + SBC 607 = 3,305 = 29.8% of revenue; the engine then deducts sbc_pct (7.9% = SBC 607 + withholding 273). Cash tax rate on owner EBIT set at 18% rising to 20%: FY2025 GAAP ETR 13.5%, FY2025 current tax 267 (11.6% of pretax), H1 2026 provision 17%, non-GAAP guided rate 16.5%; set 1-2pp above those because the engine's EBIT is after the 273 withholding (not tax-deductible as such) and because OBBBA trims the FDII deduction from 2026. FY2023-25 cash taxes paid (746 / 722 / 1,457) are inflated by taxes on Adyen and Adevinta share-sale gains and are not the operating rate. Working capital: -5% capture in base (funds-receivable and tax timing have been a modest drag on OCF). Depop: consolidated from 2026-07-30; its 1.5-2.5pt revenue contribution is inside the FY2026 guidance-year growth and the $1.4B purchase price is deducted in equity_bridge, so the deal is charged once. Horizon 10 years: margins are still ramping in year 5.
inputs.current_ev_to_owner_fcf: Market cap 49.1B + pro forma net debt 3.3B - equity securities 0.8B = EV ~51.6B; TTM owner FCF (2,428 - 969 - 240) = 1,219 and FY2025 normalised 1,289 -> ~40x. On the company's own FCF definition (2.4B) it is ~21x.

equity_bridge.item: Depop acquisition cash consideration paid 2026-07-30 (post balance-sheet date)
equity_bridge.note: Closed for ~$1.4B cash; Q2 2026 balance sheet predates the payment. Depop revenue is inside the FY2026 growth path, so the price is charged here exactly once.

equity_bridge.item: Equity securities at fair value / cost (non-operating)
equity_bridge.note: EquitySecuritiesFvNiAndWithoutReadilyDeterminableFairValue 773 at 2026-06-30 (residual Aurelia/Adevinta-related and other stakes). Their marks are excluded from the flows, so the asset is added in the bridge (matching-asset rule). Equity-method investments (48) ignored.

historical_growth.owner_fcf_series_note: reported FCF - SBC - equity-award withholding - interest income, each year (FY2025 on the normalised 2,434 base; as filed it is 289).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-3.6% 3yr, +5.3% 5yr) diverges >30% from revenue CAGR (+4.3% / +4.5%): eBay repurchases more than it earns ($2.5B buybacks + $0.5B dividends vs $2.0B net income in FY2025), so book value is a capital-return residual, not a growth signal. EPS CAGRs are distorted by mark-to-market gains/losses on Adevinta and Adyen stakes (FY2020 EPS 7.98, FY2022 -2.27). Revenue CAGR is the only clean anchor; the forward path front-loads FY2026 guidance (11-12%) and decelerates to 3%.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGR (6.1% 3yr, -0.6% 5yr) is well below reported-FCF CAGR (10.5% / 4.5%): SBC + withholding rose from 592 (FY2020) to 880 (FY2025) and interest income from 38 to 265, so a growing share of reported FCF growth is comp paid in stock and yield on the cash pile, neither of which belongs to a flat-count owner. FY2022-24 revenue was flat (9,795 / 10,112 / 10,283); the FY2025-26 re-acceleration (+8%, guided +11-12%) is the Focused-Categories / advertising / Depop story and is only two years old.

base.growth_note: FY2026: guidance 11-12% raised after Q2; H1 ran +17% as reported and Q3 guided +9-11%, so 12% implies only +5% in Q4 - 12.5% allows for the pattern of quarterly beats without assuming FX tailwinds persist. FY2027 carries seven months of Depop annualisation (+~1pt) over ~6% core FX-neutral growth, then decelerates to 3% - roughly nominal GDP - by year 8. Ten-year revenue CAGR 5.1%, versus 4.5% trailing five-year.
base.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-SBC adj EBITDA. FY2025 29.8%. FY2026 flat: guidance has non-GAAP operating income growing 10-12% on 11-12% revenue (Depop dilution offsets ad leverage). Thereafter +0.3pp/yr as first-party advertising (+25% YoY, near-zero incremental cost) outgrows marketplace revenue and Depop scales, capped at 31.5%.
base.sbc_pct_note: SBC + withholding was 7.9% of revenue in FY2025 (8.1% TTM). eBay is mature - SBC alone has sat at 5-6% of revenue for a decade - so the glide is only 0.15pp/yr: dollar SBC grows ~3%/yr while revenue grows ~5%.
base.capex_note: Capex 4.5% / 4.5% / 4.7% of revenue FY2023-25, 4.7% in H1 2026; management frames it as 4-5%. D&A 3.8% (421 in FY2025, includes Depop intangible amortisation going forward).

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 lands at the top of the raised 11-12% guide (Depop adds ~2pts, Focused Categories - collectibles, motors parts, fashion, refurbished - now over 40% of GMV and growing 20%+). Growth then fades toward 3% as Depop annualises, the FX tailwind lapses and the marketplace's flat active-buyer base reasserts itself; the FY2022-24 stagnation is the reminder that eBay's structural growth is low-single-digit once a mix-shift story matures. Margin creeps from 29.8% to 31.5% adj EBITDA on advertising take-rate (first-party ads +25% YoY, minimal incremental cost) and Depop scaling, but SBC plus withholding stays a 7-8% of revenue cost that a flat-count owner bears in full. Tariff / de minimis friction on cross-border GMV (~half of the total) and agentic-AI shopping are absorbed without breaking the trend. Terminal value is Gordon at 2.5% / 9% (15.8x, under the 18x cap).
scenario_narratives.bull: The Focused-Category and recommerce pivot proves durable rather than a two-year mix effect: Depop integrates without brand damage and grows 40%+ into a second network, eBay Live becomes a material collectibles channel, and advertising monetisation keeps climbing toward Amazon-like ad-to-GMV ratios, lifting adj EBITDA margin to 33.5%. Cross-border headwinds net out as Temu/Shein/AliExpress lose their de minimis edge relative to eBay's seller base. Revenue compounds ~7% over ten years, SBC intensity falls to 6% of revenue, and the buyback keeps taking ~3% of the count out each year at prices below intrinsic value. Terminal 3% growth at 9% (17.2x, under the 20x cap).
scenario_narratives.bear: The re-acceleration is cyclical and comp-driven, not structural: FY2027 growth collapses to 3% as Depop annualises and the FX tailwind reverses, then reverts to the ~1-2% of FY2022-24. Tariff and flat per-parcel duties dampen cross-border GMV, which peers with domestic-only volume do not feel. Agentic shopping assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google) intermediate discovery, eroding the search-driven promoted-listings ad revenue that carries eBay's margin expansion, while eBay's decision to block buy-for-me agents cedes that channel. Marketing spend to defend against Poshmark, Vinted and Mercari compresses adj EBITDA to 27.5%; SBC intensity does not fall; a terminal cap of 14x binds (Gordon at 2%/9% would be 14.6x). Not a solvency scenario - leverage stays ~1x EBITDA - but a slow ex-growth marketplace repriced as such.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the two largest downside axes - US de minimis / tariff policy on roughly half of GMV, and agentic-AI disintermediation of eBay's search-driven ad monetisation - are external, already in motion, and outside management's control, and the FY2022-24 flat-revenue period shows the ex-growth outcome is the recent history, not a hypothetical. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs Depop integration, sustained Focused-Category outgrowth and continued ad take-rate expansion all to hold simultaneously, and eBay's own consensus (17 Hold / 2 Sell of 34) reflects that scepticism. Base 50%. Balance sheet risk is nil in every scenario (net debt ~1x EBITDA pro forma Depop, investment-grade).

valuation_philosophy.summary: eBay is valued as a mature, cash-generative marketplace on a strict owner-FCF basis: SBC and the cash withheld on equity awards are expensed, interest on the $4.9B cash-and-securities pile is stripped and the pile credited once in net debt, the FY2025 FCF base is normalised for a ~$1.0B one-off tax payment on the Adevinta gain, and the Depop purchase price is charged in the bridge while its revenue sits inside the guidance-year growth. The company's own 'free cash flow' (~$2.4B) is roughly double what a flat-count owner actually keeps (~$1.3B), which is the core reason the house value sits well below the street's; the street basis is reported alongside so the reader can see how much of the price rests on treating comp as non-cash.
key_risks_to_valuation: SBC treatment: charging the $273M net-share-settlement withholding on top of the $607M expense is the house convention; on SBC-only the value is ~$8-10/share higher.

Cash tax rate: modelled at 18-20% of owner EBIT against a 13.5% FY2025 GAAP ETR and 16.5% non-GAAP guide; each 1pp is ~$1.2/share. If historic 25-30% cash-tax ratios reflect a structural rate rather than gain taxes, value is lower.
Growth durability: the model gives FY2026 12.5% but fades to 3%; if Focused Categories plus advertising can hold 6-7% for a decade (the bull path) value is ~$100+.
Terminal share: with 9% WACC and a 10-year horizon roughly 55-60% of EV is terminal value; a 1pp WACC change moves value ~15%.
Cross-border policy and agentic AI are binary-ish external risks handled through the 25% bear weight, not the discount rate.
